summary: Triage of all 84 disconnected TruthCore.Modal results (docs/notes/modal-results-triage.md; A 2, A-deferred 5, B 27, C 40, D 10). Certified MODAL-FORK-T/-S4/-KTB/-S5: each frame-class branch of the 'necessary' sense fork concludes the fork node STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-ON-INTENDED-READING from the K node, an OPEN modal schema premise (T, 4, B or 5 valid on the route's frame) and an OPEN reading premise, applying the modal library's StandardCorrespondenceCertificate and ConvergenceCertificate to derive the frame condition. MODAL-FORK-T lowers NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE-SENSE-FORK from 53 to 52. Recorded two refutations backed by existing verified Modal results: NECESSARY-POTENTIAL-CAUSERS-NOT-DISTINCT refutes STMT-MODAL-DITHEISM (does not count: open premises); SIMPLICITY-COLLAPSE-CORE refutes STMT-NECESSARY-ACT-STRICT-CONTINGENT (no premises; a constraint on the route's account of creation, not a rival of a root premise). Rejected leads: (a) using the modal-collapse laws (K/T/D/B/S4/S5) as refutations of a root rival: the root path asserts no actual contingent being, so collapse contradicts no root premise; (b) deriving box-existence of the root from #437 necessary-if-existent: the K node already gives it, so the modal theorem would do no work; (c) connecting the existence-degree results to STMT-GOD-IS-MAXIMAL-IN-BEING: needs a bridge from world-indexed Preorder degrees to MoreIn at esse and one from the selected individual to God (two bridges); (d) per-sense fork arguments from the existing per-sense nodes (BOX-T etc.) plus a reading premise: the proof only pairs hypotheses (assembly), so they were not added.
blocker: The two connected Modal results are assembly certificates, so the group's non-transcription orphan count is unchanged (77). The collapse family (27 B results) needs a root-path premise asserting an actual contingent being before any collapse rival can be recorded as alternative_to a root premise; the degree and rigid-designation results need the bridges named in the triage.
